_about: Buses (engine/fetch_surface.py, engine/surface.py). 'gtfs' says where the agency's schedule comes from: a CKAN package (ckan) or a direct zip (url). Rail routes are drawn by the 'L' layer, so only buses are kept. 'feeds' adds other agencies, each into raw/surface/<feed>/. Pace comes from OpenStreetMap ('osm', engine/osm_routes.py) because Pace offers its GTFS for non-commercial use only: routes and stops, no schedules. Its routes keep their own mode ('pace') and a 'Pace ' prefix; Pulse lines go by their names.
